available.quote: Subject to Subsections (4) through (7), the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States

requirements.value: License by endorsement available if the out-of-state license encompasses a similar scope of practice, the applicant has at least one year of experience, and the license is in good standing.
requirements.quote: the division shall issue a license to an applicant who has been licensed in another state, district, or territory of the United States if: (a) the division determines that the license issued in the other state, district, or territory encompasses a similar scope of practice as the license sought in this state; (b) the applicant has at least one year of experience practicing under the license issued in the other state, district, or territory; and (c) the applicant's license is in good standing

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in conduct defined as unlawful under the Direct-Entry Midwife Act or Title 58 generally
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Grounds for refusing to issue a license to an applicant, for refusing to renew a license, for revoking, suspending, restricting, or placing on probation a license, for issuing a public or private reprimand, and for issuing a cease and desist order shall be in accordance with Section 58-1-401.
disciplinary_grounds.citation: Section 401 - Grounds for denial of license -- Disciplinary proceedings.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to obtain informed consent from a client as described in the standards of practice section
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to obtain informed consent as described in Subsection 58-77-601(1)

disciplinary_grounds.description: Disregarding a client's dignity or right to privacy
disciplinary_grounds.quote: disregarding a client's dignity or right to privacy as to her person, condition, possessions, or medical record

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to file or record any required medical report, or impeding/obstructing such filing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failing to file or record any medical report as required by law, impeding, or obstructing the filing or recording of the report, or inducing another to fail to file or record the report

disciplinary_grounds.description: Breaching statutory, common law, regulatory, or ethical confidentiality requirements regarding clients
disciplinary_grounds.quote: breaching a statutory, common law, regulatory, or ethical requirement of confidentiality with respect to a person who is a client, unless ordered by the court

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using advertising or identification statements that are false, misleading, or deceptive
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using advertising or an identification statement that is false, misleading, or deceptive

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using 'nurse' or other title that falsely implies licensure as a certified nurse midwife, RN, or LPN
disciplinary_grounds.quote: using in combination with the term "midwife" the term "nurse" or another title, initial, or designation that falsely implies that the direct-entry midwife is licensed as a certified nurse midwife, registered nurse, or licensed practical nurse

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting a birth certificate known to be false or fraudulent
disciplinary_grounds.quote: submitting a birth certificate known by the person to be false or fraudulent

definition_quote.value: the practice of providing the necessary supervision, care, and advice to a client during essentially normal pregnancy, labor, delivery, postpartum, and newborn periods that is consistent with national professional midwifery standards and that is based upon the acquisition of clinical skills necessary for the care of a pregnant woman and a newborn baby, including antepartum, intrapartum, postpartum, newborn, and limited interconceptual care
definition_quote.quote: the practice of providing the necessary supervision, care, and advice to a client during essentially normal pregnancy, labor, delivery, postpartum, and newborn periods that is consistent with national professional midwifery standards and that is based upon the acquisition of clinical skills necessary for the care of a pregnant woman and a newborn baby, including antepartum, intrapartum, postpartum, newborn, and limited interconceptual care

drug_authority.value: May obtain and administer: prescription vitamins, Rho D immunoglobulin, sterile water, intramuscular oxytocin (one dose after delivery, additional single dose if hemorrhage), oxygen, local anesthetics without epinephrine, vitamin K, eye prophylaxis, and any other medication approved by a licensed health care provider with authority to prescribe. Unlicensed midwives may not administer prescription medications except oxygen.

prohibited_procedures.quote: A direct-entry midwife may not: (1) administer a prescription drug to a client in a manner that violates this chapter; (2) effect any type of surgical delivery except for the cutting of an emergency episiotomy; (3) administer any type of epidural, spinal, or caudal anesthetic, or any type of narcotic analgesia; (4) use forceps or a vacuum extractor; (5) manually remove the placenta, except in an emergency that presents an immediate threat to the life of the client
